channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Southwestern Vermont's freight rail is getting a major upgrade with over sixty million dollars in federal funding. The project will replace old jointed tracks with continuous welded rail to boost safety and speed. This investment also lays groundwork for possible future passenger rail service in the region.

A former Burlington school administrator is under investigation for embezzling over one point seven million dollars. The alleged theft spanned more than ten years. Authorities continue to look into the case.

Vermont State Senator Terry Williams was taken into custody for domestic assault in Poultney. The incident happened Tuesday evening and led to his arrest after police found probable cause. Williams is expected in court Wednesday to face the charges.

Pittsford hosts the twenty-first annual Wheels for Warmth tire sale on October thirty-first. The event sells affordable used tires and raises money for heating assistance programs statewide. Donations of good tires are accepted ahead of the sale to support neighbors in need.
